name: Discord
author: GM
description: Discord in the Omarchy bar: attention badge, call state, volume, window focus, memory footprint, a workspace preset, favourite voice channels you join in one press, and friend online notifications.

barWidget.description: Raise or launch Discord on a chosen workspace, join a favourite voice channel in one press, see and control the voice call, watch what it costs in memory, and get told when a watched friend comes online.

schema.label: Hide the icon when Discord is not running
